$comment: Layout contract for scripts/, enforced by scripts/gates/check-scripts-layout.mjs (pnpm audit:scripts-layout). Add a folder only for a new kind of work, not a new subsystem. List a script under manual only when nothing can call it, with why.

folders.bootstrap: Bash and PowerShell bootstrap agents and presets (product asset)
folders.build: predev/prebuild staging, sidecar/CLI/plugin builds, build-time generators
folders.ci: CI-only steps: change planning, CI report, Feishu notify, release handoff
folders.e2e: static server for out/ and the E2E governance ledger
folders.gates: read-only gates and audits with their baselines
folders.i18n: i18n aggregates, ICU validation, VS Code NLS
folders.plugin: plugin SDK/contract build and checks, authoring kit, artifacts
folders.scaffold: plugin scaffolding and typed config codegen
folders.smoke: smoke harnesses against real runtimes and services
folders.sync: generators and mirrors that double as drift gates
folders.tauri: agent-debug bridge into the real Tauri webview
folders.test: Jest / node --test entry points, sharding, coverage

manual.why: Builds the status-only static distribution after `pnpm build` (ADR-0211); deployed by hand. CI runs only its test.
Moves Rust modules from src-tauri into a crate without staging in the shared index (ADR-0196).
Grades retained HTE CEM artifacts offline (docs/development/hte-cem-grading.md).
Wire-level tool-search cache experiment; --run calls a model (docs/evidence/2026-10-24-eval-tui-gap-audit.md).
Opt-in live acceptance with real providers (docs/evidence/2026-10-21-builtin-agent-budgets.md).
Lume sandbox smoke on a macOS host (docs/development/lume-sandbox.md).
Scheduler smoke inside the desktop shell (docs/reports/2026-10-22-scheduled-task-implementation-audit.md).
Agent Team live evaluation with real models (docs/reports/2026-10-25-team-squad-live-evaluation.md).
TUI v4.1 acceptance in a real PTY (docs/evidence/2026-10-22-tui-v41-acceptance.md).
Regenerates the Live2D compatibility fixtures; pet:compat:test checks them.
Real-webview concurrency acceptance for the agent-debug bridge (scripts/tauri/AGENT_DEBUG.md).
